Case Study: How We Helped FedEx in Yuma Save on Cooling

Published on October 16, 2025

Arizona property owners face a specific problem: 299+ days of intense sun annually. At Arizona House of Film (ROC #314088), we've completed 700+ installations since 2017 helping homeowners and businesses in Yuma and across the Phoenix metro solve this with the right window film. This guide covers commercial window tint Yuma — what to know before you buy, what products work in Arizona's climate, and what real projects cost.

The Core Decision: Case Study: How We Helped FedEx in Yuma Save on Cooling

Most property owners in Yuma come to us having researched commercial window tint Yuma online but unsure which direction fits their glass, HOA requirements, and budget. The answer depends on three factors: your primary goal, your glass type, and your building's solar orientation.

We typically recommend SunTek for projects where commercial window tint Yuma is the primary objective. For applications requiring additional performance, Madico performs consistently in Arizona's UV environment and carries manufacturer warranties valid in extreme heat climates.

What Arizona's Climate Demands from Window Film

Phoenix metro averages 107°F+ days in summer. Window film specified for moderate climates often underperforms here — adhesive failure, delamination, and color shift are common with inferior products. The films we install on Yuma properties are tested to IWFA standards and backed by manufacturer warranties we can document for your records.

Our full service page covers specifications in detail. For Yuma properties specifically, we assess glass orientation, existing coating type, and HOA color restrictions before recommending any film.

Project Costs for Yuma Properties

Residential window film in Yuma typically runs $8–$18 per square foot installed depending on film series and glass access. Commercial projects are quoted per scope. We provide written quotes after on-site measurement — no per-window estimates over the phone. Call (480) 788-1591 to schedule a free assessment.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much did FedEx in Yuma save on energy costs?

In our case study, the application of SunTek commercial film led to a significant reduction in HVAC runtime, contributing to substantial energy savings and a more comfortable working environment for employees.

Is window film effective for large commercial buildings?

Yes, it is one of the most cost-effective energy efficiency upgrades for large commercial properties, offering a rapid ROI, often within 2-5 years.

Does commercial window film reduce glare on computer screens?

Yes, glare reduction is a major benefit. It improves employee comfort, work, and productivity by reducing eye strain in office environments.
